title: Repeat-Issue Credit on Error Returns - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Service recovery rule - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

An error-return refund carries a repeat-issue credit that counts the other return authorizations on the same order - in any status - whose reason is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described. The authorization being settled is not one of them.

| Other such authorizations on the order | Repeat-issue credit |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $2.50 |
| Exactly one | $1.25 |
| None | Nothing |

### What is counted

- Every status counts: authorized, received, refunded, rejected or expired.
- Only the four Tailwise-error reasons count; an authorization with reason changed mind or quality guarantee is not counted.
- Only authorizations on the same order count.

### Example (hypothetical order)

An order holds three return authorizations: the one being settled (wrong item, received), an earlier one for a damaged unit (rejected) and one for a changed mind (refunded). The other Tailwise-error authorizations number one, so the credit is $1.25.
